n = int(input())
B = int(input())
arr = [int(input()) for _ in range(n)]

countCuts = 0
oddCount = 0
evenCount = 0
maxDiffs = []

for i in range(n):
    if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenCount += 1
    else:
        oddCount += 1
    if evenCount == oddCount and evenCount != 0 and i != n - 1:
        diff = abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1])
        maxDiffs.append(diff)

maxDiffs.sort()

for d in maxDiffs:
    if B >= d:
        countCuts += 1
        B -= d

print(countCuts)
